output.review_comment: The PR correctly fixes the failing tests by: (1) switching from quote_plus to quote to encode spaces as %20 per the docstring spec, (2) adding explicit boolean conversion to lowercase "true"/"false" per the docstring, and (3) sorting parameters alphabetically to match the test expectations. The docstring was appropriately updated to reflect alphabetical ordering. All changes implement the agreed spec as encoded in the tests, and the original docstring had already claimed some of these behaviors (lowercase booleans, %20 spaces) that weren't actually implemented. This fix aligns the code with both the spec and docstring.
